options: Rewrite both strings in the generator so no em dash reaches the public, splitting each sentence at a full stop rather than swapping in a hyphen, then regenerate the 15 switch pages - the Weebly SEO description field then needs repasting at the next paste run
Fix only the meta description, since that is the string Google shows, and leave the body sentence as it is - smaller change, no visible page copy edited

The real problem is a shared marketing template sitting on the branch profiles that reads 'Whether you need a flu jab, private blood tests, or guidance on Mounjaro and Wegovy...'. Replace all ten with the pack descriptions regardless of what they currently say, so the whole estate is consistent and known-good in one pass

answer: Rishi chose the recommended option in the same session on 2026-08-07 and the work was completed there and then. All 16 profiles were checked. Eleven carried the medicine names and were replaced with their pack descriptions (Cherry Lane, Coleman & Leighs, Fishlock Eccleston, Fishlocks Ainsdale, Gordon Short, McCanns Aigburth, Riddings, Scorah Bramhall, Scorah Hazel Grove, SK Chemists, Smartts). Three needed no change (McCanns Sandringham, Clear Chemist, and the R B Healthcare head office record, which has no description and no pack). The POM exposure across the GBP estate is closed, subject to confirming the Cherry Lane edit cleared Google's review queue.
note: Advertising prescription-only medicines to the public is not permitted, so every profile still carrying the template is a live exposure until it is changed. GBP edits sometimes queue for review for up to ten minutes rather than applying instantly, and there is no undo, so the before text for each one needs logging as it is changed.
